data.content_ref: inline:Carriage-closure of attack edges: strengthen graph construction so every attacker of a validity_node also attacks the warrant (hence its carrier's attack edge), per the stated closure rule. Enforce this as a pure function of the artifact set in att construction — the fixpoint algorithm is untouched, so determinism and polynomial cost are inherited; the grounded extension is computed over a denser, more discriminating edge set. This makes the 'only route to REFUTED' chain complete: a warrant whose validity_node is attacked can never survive as a committed root.
